_readme: Copy this file to data/config.json and fill in your values. Everything you might switch later lives here: tokens, the target page, timezone and posting times. Switching pages = set pageId (or igUsername) + a fresh metaUserToken, push, done. pageAccessToken is maintained by the agent itself (permanent page token). Set autoPost to false to pause automatic posting.
pageAccessToken: (leave empty — the agent fills in the page's permanent token automatically)
igUserId: Instagram business account id (optional — auto-detected on connect)
igUsername: Instagram username (optional — used to find the page if pageId is unknown)
